objective.description: Checkout e2e suite fails intermittently in CI.

failure.stderr: TimeoutError: waiting for selector .confirm (3 of 20 runs)

expected.summary: Lead with "Repeat-run flakiness check on the affected flow" (high), then investigate before changing code. 2 test suggestions, 2 fix steps.

suggestions.title: Repeat-run flakiness check on the affected flow
suggestions.rationale: Intermittent behavior only shows under repetition; N consecutive runs expose the flake rate.

draft.description: Given the affected flow, when it is executed N times consecutively by the external runner, then all runs must pass.

suggestions.title: Nondeterminism audit (time, ordering, shared state)
suggestions.rationale: Flaky behavior usually traces to clocks, unordered collections, races, or leaked state between tests.

draft.description: Given the suspected code paths, when time, ordering, and shared state are controlled, then results are identical across runs.

steps.title: Make the failure reproducible first
steps.description: Capture seeds, timing, and environment until the failure reproduces deterministically.

steps.title: Then remove the source of nondeterminism
steps.description: With a deterministic reproduction in hand, apply a minimal fix and keep the repeat-run guard.

risks.description: Retry-based mitigation hides flakes instead of fixing them; prefer removing the nondeterminism.

evidence.detail: Caller requested stability: Checkout e2e suite fails intermittently in CI.
